description: Rail-5k: a Real-World Dataset for Railway Surface Defects Detection is a data set deposited in Zenodo by its authors Zihao Zhang (Shanghai Key Laboratory of Rail Infrastructure Durability and System Safety). To encourage research in computer vision for the railway, we present Rail-5k: a real-world image dataset for object detection of defects and accessories on the rail, along with methods for shooting, fine-frained category definition, and instance-level annotation. Coverage: global; the metadata date the deposit to 2021. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is restricted according to the metadata; the conditions were not read. The licence is not stated (no licence in the DataCite metadata read on 2026-09-29). Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
